# See whether last night's backup quietly got smaller.

> Drop backup-evidence run records in your browser to see whether last night's archive shrank or a verified job quietly got worse. Nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
